title: aira pulchella
intro: Aira pulchella, commonly known as the ornamental hair grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is native to Europe and Asia and is valued for its delicate, feathery plumes that add texture and visual interest to gardens and landscapes. The plant is also known to have potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and calming effects. Aira pulchella contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
